## Current objective: Split the monolithic `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers. A separate Elasticsearch “orders” reindex/alias-swap procedure was requested to run between other work; it is paused after cluster health check.

## Recent work: Worker memory issues were fixed by removing `BillingWorker._last_batch`, which retained raw usage batches after processing. Worker tests passed (41), and the full suite passed (118 passed, 7 skipped). Usage memory repros showed bounded pending events and stable retained memory. `ledgerly/cli.py` was partially refactored to use `_add_billing_filters()`; currency destination behavior and command tests were fixed, but help still shows duplicate `--currency/-c` entries because another command builder has not been migrated. An obsolete test assertion using `args.filters["currency"]` was updated to `args.currency`; all 22 command tests pass. For the Elasticsearch procedure, only step 1 was run: production cluster health was yellow. Do not run the remaining reindex commands until proceeding deliberately in the specified order. Operator constraints: treat fields ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy them only via `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`; pin new licensing tools to exact versions in `requirements/license-tools.txt`.

## Current objective: Fix the dunning email scheduler in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`, which sends reminders to customers whose invoices are already paid. The router split is superseded/paused. The Elasticsearch orders reindex/alias swap is also paused after reindexing, before alias swap.

## Recent work: CLI billing filters were centralized; help now has one `--currency/-c`, abbreviation regression coverage was added, and 37 focused CLI/command tests passed. `ruff` and `git diff --check` passed. Elasticsearch `orders_v2` was created with one shard, one replica, and `id`/`created_at` mappings; 18,432 documents were reindexed successfully with no failures. Do not perform the alias swap without deliberately resuming that procedure.

Webhook retry work was started before the scheduler became higher priority: `WebhookSender` now validates `max_attempts`, retries `httpx.TransportError` with bounded exponential backoff, and re-raises the final transport error. Exact test output from the last run was:

```text

6 passed in 0.84s
```

New retry tests cover eventual success and exhaustion. Move next to inspecting the dunning scheduler, paid-invoice state logic, and existing scheduler/email tests, then implement and verify a focused regression fix. Going forward, paste exact test output rather than paraphrasing it. Continue treating fields ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy them only via `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`; pin licensing tools exactly in `requirements/license-tools.txt`.
